exercises.question: Which sentence clearly reports information from a source?
options: Según la fuente oficial, el suceso ocurrió durante la noche. [According to the official source, the incident happened during the night.]
A mí me parece muy extraño todo lo que explicaron los vecinos sobre el caso. [To me everything the neighbours explained about the case seems very strange.]
No creo que sea fiable todo lo que explicaron los vecinos sobre el caso. [I do not think everything the neighbours explained about the case is reliable.]

exercises.sentence: La periodista dijo que había __ con la fuente.
exercises.english: The journalist said that she had spoken with the source.
I do not think that news is entirely accurate.

sentences: Primero aparecieron los testimonios. [First the testimonies appeared.]
Posteriormente apareció una grabación. [Subsequently a recording appeared.]
Finalmente, los investigadores publicaron un comunicado. [Finally, the investigators published a statement.]

exercises.question: Which expression normally takes the subjunctive?
options: Es posible que [It is possible that]
Es evidente que [It is clear that]
Creo que [I think that]

exercises.sentence: Es evidente que la fuente __ más información.
exercises.english: It is clear that the source has more information.
In summary, the news report is about a phenomenon without a definitive answer.

exercises.question: Which verb introduces another person's words?
options: afirmar [to state]
suceder [to happen]
difundir [to spread]

exercises.sentence: El alcalde afirmó que la fuente era fiable.
options: The mayor stated that the source was reliable.
The mayor said that the source would be reliable tomorrow.
The mayor denied that there was any source at all.

exercises.sentence: Posteriormente apareció una grabación breve en las redes sociales.
options: Subsequently a brief recording appeared on social media.
First the recording disappeared before anyone reported it.
The recording was published tomorrow.

exercises.sentence: Lo más importante es que los vecinos no tienen más información.
exercises.english: The most important thing is that the neighbours have no more information.

options: Dijo que los datos principales estaban confirmados. [It said that the main data were confirmed.]
Dijo que los datos principales estén confirmados. [It said that the main data are (subjunctive) confirmed.]
Dijo que los datos principales estarán confirmados. [It said that the main data will be confirmed.]
Es una opinión, porque no creo que la fuente sea completamente fiable. [It is an opinion because I do not think the source is completely reliable.]
Es un hecho, porque es posible que la fuente sea fiable. [It is a fact because it is possible that the source is reliable.]
Es una opinión, porque es evidente que los datos coinciden. [It is an opinion because it is clear that the data coincide.]

Primero llegaron los testimonios, posteriormente apareció un vídeo y finalmente los investigadores publicaron un comunicado. [First the testimonies arrived, subsequently a video appeared, and finally the investigators published a statement.]

Finalmente llegaron los testimonios, posteriormente apareció un vídeo y primero los investigadores publicaron un comunicado. [Finally the testimonies arrived, subsequently a video appeared, and first the investigators published a statement.]

Posteriormente llegaron los testimonios, primero apareció un vídeo y finalmente los investigadores publicaron un comunicado. [Subsequently the testimonies arrived, first a video appeared, and finally the investigators published a statement.]

exercises.question: Which sentence combines summary with evaluation?
options: En resumen, hay testimonios, pero no creo que la información sea completamente fiable. [In summary, there are testimonies, but I do not think the information is completely reliable.]
En resumen, los periodistas publicaron los primeros datos a primera hora del día. [In summary, the journalists published the initial details early in the day.]
La fuente oficial informó de la existencia de un vídeo grabado por varios vecinos. [The official source reported the existence of a video recorded by several neighbours.]

template.prompt: Report information from the witnesses (a light appeared; later a video came out) and give a cautious evaluation: you do not think the information is completely reliable yet.
template.answer: Según los testigos, apareció una luz; posteriormente surgió un vídeo. No creo que la información sea completamente fiable todavía.

template.prompt: Write a short summary (several people reported a strange phenomenon and later new evidence appeared) and respond with caution because independent evidence is still lacking.
template.answer: En resumen, varias personas informaron de un fenómeno extraño y posteriormente aparecieron nuevas pruebas. Mi reacción es de cautela porque todavía faltan pruebas independientes.
